products.name: Entra Identity Protection & Advanced Conditional Access — Commercial
products.short_description: Move beyond a basic CA baseline — enable Entra Identity Protection risk policies and advanced Conditional Access (authentication contexts, token protection, CAE).
products.description:
Move beyond a basic CA baseline — enable Entra Identity Protection risk policies and advanced Conditional Access (authentication contexts, token protection, CAE).

A static Conditional Access baseline can't react to compromise. This solution adds the risk-and-context layer: turn on Entra Identity Protection (risky users/sign-ins, risk-based policies), and deploy advanced Conditional Access — authentication contexts for step-up, token protection (bind tokens to devices), Continuous Access Evaluation, and authentication strengths — the identity core of a Zero Trust program, piloted report-only first.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Entra Identity Protection — risky user/sign-in policies, risk remediation
  • Authentication contexts for step-up on sensitive apps/actions
  • Token protection (token binding) and Continuous Access Evaluation
  • Authentication strengths (phishing-resistant) and named-location policy
  • Report-only validation, break-glass, and staged enforcement

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

An adaptive identity perimeter that reacts to risk in real time — risk-based access, step-up, and token protection over your CA baseline.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • ENTIDP-Discovery.ps1 — inventory Conditional Access, Identity Protection, named locations, auth strengths, and auth contexts
    • ENTIDP-Report.ps1 — risk-and-coverage report: risky users/sign-ins, risk-policy coverage, legacy-auth & MFA gaps
    • ENTIDP-RiskHunt.ps1 — hunt risky sign-ins and CAE/token events via KQL (Log Analytics/Sentinel) or a Graph fallback
    • ENTIDP-Set-PolicyState.ps1 — safely flip a named Conditional Access policy between report-only and enabled
    • ENTIDP-Validate.ps1 — confirm the four pilot policies are report-only, scoped, and break-glass excluded

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
